title: Binding Enchantment
description: Adds an enchantment that keeps the item after death (like keep inventory)
body:
![Binding Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02e84da2591dc714563bda5f6709b5766a6b4c33_0.webp)
# Binding
Binding is an enchantment that lets you keep specific items after death. Now there is no need to enable full keepInventory. When an item with Binding is in your inventory when you die, that item stays with you instead of dropping on the ground.


**Features:**
- Adds Binding Enchantment
  
- Works with any enchantable item
  
- Multiplayer-compatible
  
-  Doesn’t require keepInventory to be enabled (like simular projects require)
  
- Lightweight

**How does it work?**

When a player dies, the game checks if any of the players items were enchanted with binding. If some are then the chunk is forced to stay loaded and when the player respawns all binding items that were theirs are teleported to the player.
